note: Initial planning snapshot. Jira is authoritative for subsequent progress. Hours are provisional estimates, not actual effort. Human reviews and implementation remain pending.

sprints.name: ELS Sprint 1 - Foundation and inventory
sprints.goal: Agree scope and design, then demonstrate a tested API for registering students and managing equipment; preserve reviewed AI plans and evidence before implementation.

sprints.name: ELS Sprint 2 - Complete lending lifecycle
sprints.goal: Deliver and demonstrate atomic borrowing, returns, availability, overdue/history and database integrity with preserved specification and red/green evidence.

sprints.name: ELS Sprint 3 - Verified quality improvements
sprints.goal: Audit and improve generated tests, restore a deliberate defect, correct verified design issues, refactor safely and measure quality improvement.

sprints.name: ELS Sprint 4 - Delivery and presentation
sprints.goal: Verify reproducible execution and staff access, complete acceptance/report evidence and rehearse the team demonstration before the submission deadline.

epics.title: Project planning and responsible AI
epics.goal: Maintain proposal, Scrum evidence, effort records, human decisions, and AI disclosure throughout development.

epics.title: Requirements architecture and API foundation
epics.goal: Specify the equipment domain and API, maintain layered design decisions, reproducible setup, and shared validation conventions.

epics.title: Student and equipment management
epics.goal: Deliver tested student records and equipment inventory with unique identifiers, validation, and history preservation.

epics.title: Safe equipment lending lifecycle
epics.goal: Deliver atomic borrowing, returns, availability, overdue detection, and searchable history.

epics.title: Testing review and measured quality
epics.goal: Preserve test-first history, audit generated tests, conduct a deliberate-defect experiment, review design, refactor safely, and measure improvement.

epics.title: Deployment documentation and submission
epics.goal: Deliver staff access controls, reproducible execution, acceptance evidence, maintenance planning, final report, and a rehearsed team presentation.

tasks.title: Review proposal and confirm team working agreement
tasks.acceptance: Review docs/proposal.md and team plan with all four members; record corrections and the team decision; submit the proposal before substantial implementation; verify instructor repository and board access without claiming submission or access until checked.

tasks.title: Define requirements and observable acceptance criteria
tasks.acceptance: Create uniquely identified functional and verifiable non-functional requirements, glossary, stakeholder assumptions, exclusions, priorities and traceability skeleton; specify unique email/inventory code, dates, HTTP outcomes and privacy; all Sprint 1 stories have testable acceptance criteria before coding.

tasks.title: Model domain architecture and database decisions
tasks.acceptance: Create distinct domain and implementation models for Student, Equipment and Loan; document controller/service/repository boundaries, ER relationships, borrowing sequence, date convention, concurrency alternatives and selected database; add decision records with alternatives and trade-offs; peer review before feature implementation.

tasks.title: Bootstrap build database and agent context
tasks.acceptance: Create Maven Wrapper and Spring Boot skeleton with pinned compatible supported dependencies, reproducible configuration and database setup; add project-specific AGENTS.md with reviewed-plan requirement and Subject protection; run build and smoke test; document exact commands; no lending implementation.

tasks.title: Register retrieve and update student records
tasks.acceptance: As university staff I want to register and maintain borrowers so loans reference valid students. POST returns 201, GET and PUT work for an existing ID, unknown IDs return 404, invalid names/emails return 400, duplicate normalized email returns 409; use DTOs and service rules; include meaningful service/controller/database tests and API examples.

tasks.title: Create list update and delete equipment
tasks.acceptance: As university staff I want to manage physical equipment so inventory stays accurate. Unique inventory code; valid create returns 201; list/update work; missing item returns 404; invalid payload returns 400; duplicate code returns 409; delete unreferenced item returns 204; specify preservation of future loan history and cover persistence behavior; tests and examples pass.

tasks.title: Define testing strategy GQM goals and evidence map
tasks.acceptance: Document unit, controller, database, integration, system and acceptance testing with owners, data, environment, entry/exit criteria and limitations; define GQM questions and metric collection including service line coverage target 80 percent as a team target; create reference-practice map and truthful effort/AI-log templates; no invented results.

tasks.title: Implement shared validation and API error contract
tasks.acceptance: Define and implement consistent JSON errors for 400 validation, 404 missing record, 409 business conflict and sanitized 500 failures; map service exceptions centrally; verify stable error fields and that stack traces/internal details are not returned; coordinate shared code ownership with student/equipment owners.

tasks.title: Specify borrowing feature and review agent plan
tasks.acceptance: Write substantial borrowing specification covering preconditions, normal/error flows, data, interfaces, constraints, concurrency, acceptance criteria, forbidden changes and completion conditions; ask an agent for understanding/files/commands/tests/plan; all four review and record approval or corrections before lending implementation; preserve spec commit.

tasks.title: Peer review student contract and domain privacy
tasks.acceptance: Review Mostafa's requirements and planned student API for ambiguous acceptance criteria, unnecessary personal data, uniqueness and error outcomes; log accepted/modified/rejected feedback and corrections; synchronize models and contract; review before P05 implementation.

tasks.title: Add automated build and test pipeline
tasks.acceptance: Add repository CI that checks out source, configures the selected JDK, runs Maven Wrapper verification and reports failure; ensure local command matches CI; record actual remote result if run, otherwise mark remote verification pending; preserve deliberate red-phase evidence on a feature branch without breaking the main branch.

tasks.title: Run Sprint 1 review retrospective and effort reconciliation
tasks.acceptance: Demonstrate student and equipment API increment; record review feedback, acceptance results, initial estimate versus actual effort including AI/review/test time, blockers and backlog changes; retrospective identifies one improvement; confirm Sprint 2 scope and capacity with all members; retain evidence links.

tasks.title: Commit failing borrowing tests before implementation
tasks.acceptance: Translate approved borrowing criteria into reviewed test oracles; commit tests before lending code; run and retain expected red output for missing student/item, dates, active-loan conflict and success; preserve meaningful behavior failures; obtain human review of minimal implementation plan before P14; do not squash away red/green history.

tasks.title: Create loans atomically and prevent double borrowing
tasks.acceptance: As staff I want a valid loan recorded once so one item cannot be lent twice. Existing student/item plus due date later than borrowing date yields 201; missing references 404, invalid dates 400, active-loan conflict 409; transaction plus database/locking strategy prevents two simultaneous successes; retain green result and specification comparison; real target-database concurrency test required.

tasks.title: Record returns once and restore availability
tasks.acceptance: As staff I want to record a return so equipment becomes available and history is preserved. Valid return works; missing loan 404, second return 409, return before borrowing date 400; no history deletion; test state changes, boundary dates, and borrowing again after return.

tasks.title: List availability overdue loans and filtered history
tasks.acceptance: As staff I want current availability, overdue loans and history so I can manage lending. available=true excludes active loans; overdue means no return and due date strictly before the agreed current date; due today is not overdue; student/equipment filters return matching history and empty lists when none; deterministic Clock-based tests cover boundaries.

tasks.title: Verify full lending workflow and database integrity
tasks.acceptance: Run register/add/borrow/reject duplicate/return/borrow again/history end-to-end; exercise concurrent requests against the chosen delivery database and assert exactly one loan created and one conflict; enforce deletion restriction for equipment with any historical loan; validate invalid requests do not partially write; record observed results.

tasks.title: Update API examples diagrams and specification alignment
tasks.acceptance: Publish runnable sample requests/OpenAPI for implemented endpoints; update class/data/sequence/state diagrams to actual code; link requirements to implementation and tests; classify substantial spec criteria as implemented, ambiguous or missed and resolve gaps; peer review without exposing real student data.

tasks.title: Record Sprint 2 demonstration retrospective and effort
tasks.acceptance: Demonstrate complete lending MVP; preserve red/test, green/implementation and regression links; reconcile estimates and actual effort; record feedback, AI rework and one process improvement; plan remaining quality work.

tasks.title: Audit generated tests and correct three weaknesses
tasks.acceptance: Manually audit a representative set of at least ten AI-assisted tests as meaningful, weak, wrong oracle or missing scenario; record requirement/reason/correction; fix at least three identified weaknesses; retain before/after diffs and passing regression results; humans verify expected behavior.

tasks.title: Run deliberate defect experiment and restore implementation
tasks.acceptance: Establish green baseline; temporarily reverse a lending/date rule or remove a validation; run relevant tests and record failures and unexpected passes; restore correct code and run full suite; explain detection gaps; do not merge or leave the deliberate defect.

tasks.title: Review design and correct two important verified findings
tasks.acceptance: Ask agent to review substantial codebase for responsibilities, coupling, validation, privacy, contracts and test gaps; classify critical/important/minor; human verifies findings and records accepted/modified/rejected decisions with evidence; correct at least two important verified concerns and rerun tests; avoid manufacturing defects.

tasks.title: Document and perform three safe refactorings
tasks.acceptance: Identify at least three actual smells, affected code and suitable refactorings; for each retain before state, green baseline, change, passing tests, after state and maintainability explanation; no behavior changes disguised as refactoring; synchronize design/context.

tasks.title: Measure coverage static analysis and quality improvement
tasks.acceptance: Run JaCoCo and suitable static analysis such as PMD/SpotBugs; record actual coverage, warnings and relevant complexity; confirm one significant measured issue, correct it, rerun tools and compare; complete GQM results/interpretation/action; target at least 80 percent service line coverage without replacing meaningful assertions.

tasks.title: Review Sprint 3 quality evidence and remaining release risks
tasks.acceptance: Present verified test audit, mutation, review/refactoring and measurement evidence; record effort and retrospective; check all mandatory numerical criteria; prioritize remaining release blockers without inventing completed evidence.

tasks.title: Package application and verify clean setup
tasks.acceptance: Provide Dockerfile/.dockerignore or justified reproducible packaging, database configuration, synthetic seed data and runbook; from a clean clone run build/tests/start and key workflows; verify env vars and no secrets; record actual results and limitations; reliable local demo required even if hosting unavailable.

tasks.title: Verify staff access privacy and dependency licensing
tasks.acceptance: Define and enforce staff-only access for delivery (single staff credential via environment is sufficient; no student portal); test unauthenticated rejection and authorized workflow; use synthetic data and sanitized logs/errors; review dependency legitimacy/licenses and secret exposure; document local network and deployment boundary.

tasks.title: Execute acceptance scenarios and final regression
tasks.acceptance: Run agreed principal workflows and error/boundary/concurrency cases in delivery environment; record preconditions, steps, expected/observed outcome, pass/fail and follow-up; full automated suite passes; link every core requirement to result/evidence and explicitly record limitations.

tasks.title: Consolidate report reference traceability and maintenance plan
tasks.acceptance: Prepare report covering scope, decisions, teamwork, lifecycle evidence, estimate/actual reflection, AI disclosure and lessons; complete reference-practice table with direct links; discuss corrective/adaptive/perfective/preventive maintenance, debt and dependency/schema/context/test updates; include actual results only; review with all four members.

tasks.title: Prepare slides and rehearse individual explanations
tasks.acceptance: Prepare concise presentation and deterministic live demo with reset/backup; each member explains problem, architecture, own feature, test oracle, corrected AI output and quality improvement; rehearse debugging/questioning and handovers; record issues and fixes; every member understands principal decisions.

tasks.title: Complete release review retrospective and submission checklist
tasks.acceptance: Verify source/tests/docs/AI logs/reports/deployment links, incremental history, instructor access and subject exclusion from tracked files; record final sprint review/retro and effort; identify submission owner Hussein Chreif and confirm submission deadline time; mark submission complete only with actual receipt; reserve the final buffer for fixes and submission.
